title: Friend’s Motivation
paragraphs: “Understood. So, what should we do?”
“Filolials are monsters, right? Are we planning to take the Filolials from the castle?”
“The Filolials at the castle are fine, but I’ll go buy them.”

I have no intention of discriminating against the Filolial queens, but I still want to secure Yuki-chan and the others as soon as possible. In terms of immediate combat strength, it’s not a bad idea, but the Filolials at the castle also have their own lives and duties. Taking away Filolials who already have masters other than me would weigh on my conscience.
“I see…”
“No worries. I have a reliable Filolial breeder I’ve been working with for a while, so I’ll buy from them again.”
I looked toward the queen.
“With the queen here, we have enough funds, so I’d like to buy in bulk. I’m thinking of purchasing 100 of them.”
Father and the others were dumbfounded. What’s wrong? During the previous loop, I raised 500 of them.
“Mother… this looks fun. It’s the establishment of a Filolial army.”
As expected of Fiancée. She understands the magnificence of Filolial queens.
“Melty, calm down.”
“Yes…”
Fiancée is asserting herself. She’s being quite reserved, though.
“Well, wouldn’t it be better to start with a smaller number? You won’t be able to manage that many.”
“Really? Father seemed to handle it easily last time.”
“We’re still low level. We need to train ourselves first.”
“About the financial assistance… it’s not impossible, but 100 might be too many. It could cause trouble for the supplier.”

Well, that’s true. If we raise them all at once, there’s a risk that management will become insufficient. Cal Mira Island was close to Melromarc, so we had some flexibility, and the Nosferatu Great Forest was under Faubrey’s territory. But now, there’s no infrastructure to support a large number of raised Filolials. Ren, Itsuki, and Father all want to prioritize strengthening themselves first, so I reluctantly agreed.
“So, Motoyasu-kun. Filolials are fine, but what about human personnel?”
“The soldiers of Melromarc are hardly trustworthy. I think it’s best to gather and raise people from the village where the older sister was.”
“Wait, you mean children from Raphtalia-chan and Rifana-chan’s hometown?”

Father glanced at the older sister and her friend. The older sister had that creepy, forced smile on her face but seemed unwilling to agree. On the other hand, her friend clenched her fists, showing a readiness to agree enthusiastically.
“If possible, I’d like to secure the older sister’s older sister as well.”
“Raphtalia-chan’s older sister?”
I nodded. The older sister’s older sister is a very reliable person.
“That’s right.”
“Raphtalia-chan is an only child, so… um, do you mean Sadina-oneechan?”
The older sister’s friend tilted her head and answered.
“I believe that was her name. She’s a heavy drinker and very strong. She gets unnaturally close with Father.”
“Hmm… I wonder what kind of person she is. Maybe she’s easygoing?”
“She’s a very kind person. Right, Raphtalia-chan?”
“Y-Yeah!”
The older sister nodded in response.
“By the way, she’s skilled at using lightning magic and specializes in electrocuting her enemies.”
“She sounds like someone I’d be both curious and scared to meet.”
“So, Motoyasu-kun, do you know where this Sadina person is?”
“I forgot to ask.”
Father nearly stumbled at my response. What a comedian.
“You don’t know?”
“I only met the older sister’s older sister in the previous loop.”
I explained how the older sister’s older sister had joined us in Zeltoble. When Father was trying to recruit Panda, for some reason, the older sister’s older sister showed up instead.
“So, in other words, Naofumi was trying to recruit Panda, but ended up attracting that woman?”
“Exactly! She was all over Father, completely playful.”
“Hmm… then I guess we’ll have to look for her at that tavern in Zeltoble tonight?”
We’ll be recreating the situation. The problem is that since the timing is different, we don’t know what will happen.
“Anyone else?”
“Are those the only ones who ended up as slaves?”
“Of course not. If it’s just yesterday or today, I think we could find Keel if we search.”
“You’ve even met Keel-kun?”
“Indeed. In the loop before the last one, I ordered him from the slave trader and they brought him in.”
Father and the others exchanged slightly uneasy glances.
“Well, since Raphtalia-chan and the others were treated as slaves, I can kind of understand… But did I really buy slaves?”
“In the first world, you managed the entire village.”
Ah, I remember the reactions that come after this.
“I don’t understand the version of me that Motoyasu-kun has seen!”

“It’s like a conspiracy where no one believes him, and he apparently gets really agitated. Ren even said something like, ‘If anything, Naofumi is more like the village’s slave!’ or something like that.”

I don’t remember the details very well. Then, Father looked at Ren. Ren shook his head, looking offended. In the previous loop, Ren would have quickly averted his gaze. There are still some differences.
“The conversation’s drifting, but how about taking the children from Raphtalia-san and Rifana-san’s village with us as potential allies while also helping restore their hometown?”
“That might not be a bad idea.”
“Still… I think they might have some emotional issues.”
Father shifted his gaze to the older sister. Ren and Itsuki also noticed his intent.
“But… um, please help us! I’ll do my best! Cough!”
The older sister’s friend pleaded with Father. The older sister also bowed her head a beat later.
“It’s not that I won’t let you help. I heard you out earlier. It’s just that we’ll be fighting monsters wherever we go next. I’m worried if the two of you will be okay with that.”
“Eh…”
The older sister’s forced smile wavered slightly. On the other hand, the older sister’s friend looked determined.
“We’ll do our best! Right, Raphtalia-chan? We have to get stronger!”
The older sister seemed hesitant. She was quite different from the older sister I remember. The older sister I know would have been more courageous and shown determination here.
“Having a higher Lv is better, don’t you think? No matter what you’re doing. Even restoring the village would be easier with strength.”
The older sister once again forced a smile and nodded at her friend’s words.
Isn’t she trying to show some determination?
“Raphtalia-chan…”
The older sister’s friend muttered worriedly, watching her.
“Then today, let’s do our best to gather as many people as possible from Raphtalia-chan and Rifana-chan’s village.”
“Yeah. I’m not a fan of gathering people, but if what Motoyasu says is true, it’s not a bad idea.”
“Indeed. Then, I suppose that’s good for today? We can set off for the activation event tomorrow or the day after.”

It looks like the discussion is coming together. Today, we’ll be gathering the village’s slaves, the Filolials, and the older sister’s older sister. We’ll postpone hiring Panda since the employment cost is high. First, we need to raise Father’s Lv.
“After that, we’ll get stronger while being cautious of reincarnators and transplants.”
“To do that, we should hide the fact that we’re heroes and focus on the event.”
“That sounds pretty difficult.”
“Then let’s arrange for the kingdom’s slave traders. Kitamura-sama, where would be best?”
This is where I use my knowledge of the future to determine which monster merchant to ask.
“Well then—”
I explained to Father what kind of person the monster merchant he usually favored was.
“Understood. I’ll make the arrangements.”
And so, we headed to the monster merchant.
Chapter 769 – Watermark

It’s a back alley. I’m casting a spell to flush out and burn any hidden assassins from the Three Heroes Church. Since I’ve already explained this to the queen, there’s no chance of any of her faction’s shadows hiding. Well, after that, Father negotiated with the monster merchant for business purposes.
“However, I’m surprised that a hero is interested in slaves. Yes.”
“As the Shield Hero, there’s no way I can get comrades in this country, right? I’ll use whatever I can.”
He responded sharply, knowing that backing down here wasn’t an option. This is exactly how Father negotiated in the previous loop.
“Naofumi-san looks surprisingly good at bargaining.”
“Yeah, it’s like his usual carefree, sloppy expression is a lie.”
Ren and Itsuki are completely in spectator mode, watching Father. This is where Father proves reliable.
“However… hasn’t the queen already ordered the slaves to be freed? Isn’t this a wasted effort?”
“There’s still a fair bit of confusion within the country. It’s also about asking this slave trader to look for people from that village.”
“Yes. That’s what Mother instructed. Since there’s no such thing as a registry, identifying them takes time.”
Oh, Fiancée is adding supplementary information.
“Mother also said she would like a description of any physical characteristics you can remember.”
“Wasn’t there the daughter of the person who managed that land?”

“Knight Éclair-sama values martial arts and etiquette more than administration, so while she may remember the people in her territory, it’s assumed that she’s not very familiar with Raphtalia-san and Rifana-san’s village.”
“I see…”
“If possible, if this Sadina person the Spear Hero mentioned is around, it would help us identify them faster…”
“We don’t know her whereabouts.”
“As it stands, our country can only focus on gathering information.”
“I see… Ideally, we’d gather the slaves while steadily leveling up.”
“But unfortunately, there’s an activation event going on.”
Ren and Itsuki exchange troubled nods.
“Under Mother’s orders, surprise inspections of noble estates are planned to uncover abused slaves. Therefore, it’s recommended that the heroes grow stronger quickly.”
“Ah, so the queen understood what happened when Motoyasu and I went on that rescue mission.”
“Yes. It’s believed that the nobles in our country are hiding similar facilities for abusive purposes.”
“They’re rotten to the core.”
Hmm… should I purchase a Filolial here? I can probably get Kuro-chan now.
What should I do? I’m conflicted. For now, I’ll nudge Fiancée’s shoulder.
“Would it be okay to buy some Filolials here?”
“Ah, yes… a few should be fine.”
The problem is that bringing too many might cause issues.
“Then I’ll ask the monster merchant later.”
Buying Kuro-chan would definitely not be a waste. It’s better to quickly purchase Yuki-chan and the others afterward.
“Hm? What’s this?”
Ren and Itsuki noticed the monster lottery in the corner of the tent.
“Ah, that’s the monster egg lottery. Father used it to buy Filolial eggs both in the previous and the loop before that.”
“Oh…”
At that moment, one of the monster merchant’s subordinates subtly signaled to ask what to do. Ren and Itsuki aren’t participating, but they’re peeking in out of curiosity.
Shall I take a look too?
Hmm… if I recall correctly, Luna-chan’s egg should be here. I should be able to identify it by scent, but I can’t find it.
Maybe it hasn’t been stocked yet?
“Buying monster eggs through a lottery, huh?”
“If you buy ten, you’re guaranteed to get a winning egg from this special box. Yes.”
The monster merchant’s subordinate explained to Ren and Itsuki.
“Wait… I think I’ve seen this online before.”
“This is totally a gacha. And the illegal kind…”
“A complete-the-set type?”
Ren and Itsuki look at the egg lottery with a bit of exasperation. But they quickly composed themselves.
“It’s not like only Filolials can be allies. It might be fine to consider taming other pets.”
“True. We don’t know how strong they’ll be, but it’s not necessarily a bad idea.”
“Well, if we have the resources, we can consider it. It looks interesting.”
Luna-chan… where are you?
Oh? I smell a familiar scent. I’m really tempted to get it, but having too many might be a problem.
“Motoyasu-san is sniffing the eggs intently…”
“Can he tell the difference?”
Fiancée looks puzzled. Of course, I can tell.
“It’s because he’s looping.”

Ren and Itsuki, looking disinterested, turned their backs. At this point, I should stick to the usual plan and buy Yuki-chan and the others. And just then, the spear twitched slightly… and one of the eggs in the lottery box began to glow with a red pattern. T-This is… I sense something extremely unpleasant from this egg. Casually, I picked up the glowing egg.
“U-Um? Would you like to give it a try?”
The monster merchant’s subordinate was staring intently at the egg I had picked up.
This is…! I pressed the money I had on hand into the subordinate’s palm. Of course, this is the money I received from the queen.
Would about 25 gold coins be enough?
“I’ll be taking this, but please don’t make a fuss about it, okay? Report it to the monster merchant over there later.”
“U-Understood… but that egg is…”
“I know what it is, and I’m keeping it quiet.”
I released a bit of killing intent to intimidate the monster merchant’s subordinate.
“Y-Yes. Understood.”
In the end, it’s going to be a profit for the monster merchant, so they probably won’t pursue this matter too deeply. I casually glanced over at Father, Ren, Itsuki, and the others.
Hm? It feels like the friend of the big sis was looking over here, but I’ll just ignore it. I quickly hid the egg in my pocket.
“You were planning to jack up the price and sell a fake, weren’t you? I won’t let that happen.”

“What!? We pride ourselves on our trustworthiness. Yes. Since the Wave hit Melromarc, there are new slaves who were captured. If we search among them, we should be able to find the ones you’re looking for. Of course, the price will increase depending on the buyback amount. What would you like to do?”
“Then, silver coins…”
Well, Father seems to have finished negotiating with the monster merchant. As always, his skill is impressive.
“Now, it’s time for the Filolials!”
“Yeah.”
Father stepped aside, and I approached the monster merchant.
“Filo-tan.”
“Huh?”
“Motoyasu-kun?”
Oops, I let it slip without thinking.
“Is Motoyasu’s head really okay?”
“He does act suspiciously sometimes. Could it be a side effect of looping?”
“He’s not saying anything wrong, so we have no choice but to trust him, but let’s stay on guard.”
I could hear Ren and Itsuki chatting in the background.
“I want a Filolial egg.”
So, I checked the Filolial eggs prepared by the monster merchant.
Hmm… they’re all the same ones I met in the previous loop. Oh, it looks like Kuro-chan’s egg is still available. Alright, I’ll secure it.
“Thank you very much. We’ll be expecting your visit tomorrow.”
After finishing our negotiations, we left the monster merchant’s tent.
“With this, we should be able to gather a decent number, right?”
“Yeah, I think so.”
The big sis and her friend seemed a little frightened. Well, considering their experience as slaves, it’s probably stirring up some trauma. But worrying about that won’t get us anywhere.
By tomorrow, Keel and some of the other slaves should have gathered to some extent, right? That’s what Father gently told the big sis and her friend, reassuring them.
Chapter 770 – Foresight
“Why don’t we head to the weapon shop next? The old man there was worried about Naofumi.”
“Good idea. He’s got quite a collection of rare weapons. It’s definitely worth a visit.”
With that, we headed to the weapon shop, where the old man let Father copy some shields.
“You guys have been through a lot, huh? But man, I was shocked. The queen herself came to my shop.”
“Did you manage to sell her enough? Make sure to give me a cut of the profit later.”
Father was chatting casually with the weapon shop’s old man.
“Nah, I didn’t sell her anything. Anyway, you lot should buy something too. I’ll even throw in a little discount.”
“Then, should we buy something for Raphtalia-chan and Rifana-chan?”
“Yes! Cough!”
The big sis’s friend raised her hand energetically but immediately coughed afterward. Meanwhile, the big sis herself kept her forced smile, though she was trembling slightly.
“Uh… is that girl okay?”
“Hmm…”
“W-What do you mean?”
The big sister responded as if she was offended. But her voice had a hint of fear in it.
“Just a little worried.”
“The darkness in this country runs deep.”
Fiancée closed her eyes quietly and nodded.
“What’s the budget? Well, judging by their looks, they’re probably beginners, so…”

As expected, the old man at the weapon shop was giving the big sister and her friend a lesson on using daggers, just like he did when he taught Keel. The big sister and her friend seemed a little excited after Father bought them weapons and armor. That said, the big sister’s eyes still looked slightly unfocused and uneasy.
“Raphtalia-chan.”
“Y-Yes!?”
“It’s okay to use it for cooking or whatever too, you know?”
“Yes. Rifana-chan, are you okay?”
“Yeah. I’m a little scared, but I’ll do my best.”
They seem close. It’s always good to see people getting along.
“Well, we’ve taken care of most of our errands. What should we do next?”
“We still haven’t bought the Filolials!”
Father and the others were already giving off the vibe that they were ready to head home, so I protested. That’s right. We must purchase the Filolials.
“Oh, right.”
“Didn’t we already buy one?”
“One isn’t enough!”
Kuro-chan was rare, so I only bought that one.
“It’s different from the Filolials I usually buy after looping.”
Filo-tan is not with the monster merchant. And I need to introduce Sakura-chan, the Filolial who will protect Father. This time, I’m sure she’ll protect the ladies too.
“Then, next is buying the Filolials who are Motoyasu-kun’s companions? Shall we go?”
“Yes, indeed!”
I took Father and the others through the portal to the Filolial breeder.
“Wow… such a big Filolial ranch… I think this place is… very famous.”
Oh, Fiancée knows how famous this place is. As usual, I purchased the eggs of Yuki-chan, Kou, and Sakura-chan.
“Father, this is Sakura-chan’s egg… the Filolial who will protect you.”
“Then, today’s plans are more or less on track?”
“Once the portal’s cooldown is over, we’ll go to Zeltbull to look for the big sister’s sister.”
“Got it. But I guess we shouldn’t stay out drinking too late.”
“We need to avoid drawing too much attention.”
“Yeah. I just want to get stronger quickly so we can move around freely.”
Fiancée was leaning against the fence, waving at the Filolials.
“Um… can we watch the Filolials a little longer?”
“I think it’s fine since there’s a cooldown. Oh, there’s a petting area over there. Want to check it out? Raphtalia-chan and Rifana-chan should come too.”
“Yes.”
“A ranch, huh? We had one in the village too.”
“Yeah!”
Father and the others were relaxing near the Filolial ranch, each doing their own thing. As we chatted and passed the time, the cooldown ended, and it was time to leave.
“Portal Spear, here we go!”
Just before teleporting…
I casually took the egg hidden in my pocket and tossed it into the stream behind me.
Hmph… my rival must have possessed the egg through my spear, but that won’t work on me.

There’s no way I’m letting you take Father’s innocence! But since it’s parasitizing the spear, if I kill it, it might just possess another egg. So, after it possesses the egg, throwing it away like this ensures it loses contact with us. Now, all I can do is pray that we don’t cross paths again.
Hahaha! I laughed to myself—right at that moment.
“Just as planned! Na-no-na-no-na-no!”
A mysterious voice echoed through my mind.

W-What is this? Why do I feel so uneasy!? But I brushed it off as just my imagination, and we headed to Zeltbull. After arriving in Zeltbull, I taught Father how to register the egg that would hatch into Sakura-chan, and then we moved to the tavern.
“So, what kind of person is Sadina? According to Motoyasu-kun, she’s really strong and takes good care of people.”
“Sadina-neesan? She’s kind and really strong, right, Raphtalia-chan?”
“Yeah. She loves alcohol.”
“I see. I hope we can meet her.”
Father’s words made the big sister and her friend nod. Yes, that’s right. We’ll surely meet her soon.
“What does she look like?”
“Um… she’s an aquatic beastman. I think it was a Luka species?”
“I’m not really sure…”
“You mean the appearance of the big sister’s sister?”
“Yeah. Motoyasu-kun, you know her, right? What’s she like?”
“In her demi-human form, she’s about the same height as Father, and I’d say she has a good figure. In her beast form, she’s an orca.”
At that, the big sister and her friend tilted their heads.
“Did Sadina-neesan ever have a demi-human form?”
“Hmm…? I don’t think so.”
“Raphtalia-chan and Rifana-chan say she doesn’t, but what about it?”
Oh? Do the big sister and her friend not know?
“Now that I think about it, she did tend to stay in her beast form most of the time. I heard that she rarely took her demi-human form around people she was familiar with.”
In the previous loop, she stayed in her demi-human form quite often. There might have been a reason, but I never heard it.
“Hmm… so, she’s coming to this tavern, and I should just wait and recruit her, right?”
“That’s right.”
“Though, wouldn’t it be better to go look for her instead of waiting?”
“That’s true as well. Shall I go search for her?”
“Can’t we use the Hero’s authority or the Queen’s orders to look for her?”
Oh, that’s a good idea.
As expected of Father!
“Well, part of the reason we’re waiting here is to gather companions before taking on the activation event. I hope we can meet up with her…”
We need to get stronger quickly.
“When do we depart?”
“It’s best to leave as soon as we take custody of Keel and the other slaves from the monster merchant. Otherwise, waiting here would be pointless.”

Once I finish raising Yuki-chan and the others who will hatch tomorrow, leveling up Father and the others will be a breeze. If possible, we should make use of the activation to strengthen them while also raising their potential.
“Got it. Then I’ll talk to the tavern master and tell him that if someone named Sadina comes by, there’s someone looking for her under Raphtalia-chan and the others’ names.”
Saying that, Father casually approached the tavern master to ask. Being fearless is one of Father’s strengths.
